name: Belrise Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, Belrise Industries Limited manufactures Automotive Sheet Metal and casting parts, Polymer components, Suspension, and mirror systems for automotives.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile:[1] Belrise Industries is a premier automotive component manufacturer specializing in safety-critical systems for two-wheelers, passenger vehicles, and agricultural machinery.
cons: Stock is trading at 3.23 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -5.32%
Company has a low return on equity of 13.3% over last 3 years.

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order 21 Nov - Customs order upholds ₹22.91 lakh duty drawback recovery; ₹4 lakh penalty remanded.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript 20 Nov - Q2 FY27 earnings call transcript: revenue ₹27,464 mn, PAT ₹1,663 mn; new smartphone, aerospace, CV orders.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome 16 Nov - Audio recording of earnings call for Q2/H1 FY2026-27 available on Belrise website.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Monitoring Agency Report 14 Nov - Monitoring agency report for Q2 FY27: IPO and QIP proceeds utilized, no deviations reported.

Key Performance Indicators Of The Company For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026. 13 Nov - Belrise Industries disclosed Q2 FY27 KPIs; revenue rose 16.69% to ₹27,463.82 million, PAT to ₹1,665.47 million.
